profile.headline: Principal Software Engineer at Schneider Electric
profile.geoLocationName: Las Cruces, New Mexico, United States
profile.summary: I'm a dedicated self starter that enjoys the challenges of designing and developing software solutions.  I have a wide range of programming skills and am able to quickly adapt to new platforms and tools.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Develop SOA software solutions in Java.  Software developed in an agile environment (using tools like Rally to track sprints).  Much of the software integrates with legacy systems running in *nix environments (Linux and Unix).  Currently the Tech Lead on one of the teams helping to develop the companies next generation CRS.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Design, maintain and enhance existing Market Data and Order Management Server software for the company.
• Senior Engineer for developing and enhancing the internal common library software used as the core for all new server development.

positions.title: Senior Software Architect
positions.description: The engineering core of our department in Instinet was sold "whole" to Zone Securities and I maintained my Architect / Senior Software Engineer role started at Instinet working on the core server framework and new server development.

positions.title: Senior Software Architect
positions.description: • Developed and designed internal framework software used by all new server development.  This framework was the core for all new server development.  This framework sat on top of an existing, proven generic patterns based open source framework called ACE.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Lead engineer on the conversion from Spear Leads Kellogg clearing to Instinet Clearing Services
• Developed diagnostic tools for assisting Tech support and developers track down problems (Disaster Recovery Tool).
• Developed scripts and programs to facilitate automated testing of the order server systems.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Primary function was to lead advanced R&D efforts.  The elaw system is an Java Enterprise system using stateless EJBs with an Oracle DB back end. Some of the major projects I was directly responsible for include:
• Designed, developed partner multithreaded integration system for searching using Apache / Jakarta Tomcat servlet engine with Jakarta XML parsing and rendering taglibs.  All data models rendered from XML using style sheets. Optionally provided raw XML to partners from the same XML Data model. 
• Designed eLaw DIT and led development effort for building, deploying and integrating LDAP into the application using OpenLDAP on Linux.
• Converted all logging from system out to Log4j system.  Allowed selective logging to separate files based upon property file settings.  Additionally allowed real-time switching of logging levels.
• Co-designed and developed improved workflow using a data driven object model with EJB and Java Messaging technologies.

positions.title: Senior Software Architect
positions.description: Designed and maintained the back end software systems used by the DrKoop.com website.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Developed and maintained the ARDIS connection for call centers.  Developed and maintained the software behind the call center IVR.   Developed server side applications for supporting the service center.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Developed and maintained the ARDIS connection for call centers. Developed and maintained the software behind the call center IVR. Developed server side applications for supporting the service center.

positions.title: Software Consultant
positions.description: Developed a proprietary database connector DLL for use with the front end gui application.

positions.title: Programmer / Analyst
positions.description: Developed and maintained the custom document storage and retrieval software.  USI developed software integrated multiple disparate systems into one cohesive system.  Developed custom per customer solutions to solve their complex document management needs.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Developed raster based mapping tools for the primary product.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Developed custom software for controlling full house automation systems.  Communicated via serial and IR communications channels to and from the individual systems for Audio, Visual, Climate Control and other custom automation solutions.

positions.title: Software Analyst
positions.description: Developed and maintained the control and monitoring software running the residential HVAC system. Software monitored the system in real time and used adaptive behavior algorithms to minimize On-Peak power consumption.

volunteerExperiences.role: Officer, Driver, Observer, Medic, ICT Operations, Fire and Flood Evacuation
volunteerExperiences.description: Perform volunteer duties with the Yavapai County Jeep Posse for Search and Rescue, Fire and Flood evacuation.  I have also performed roles in the Incident Command Team structure for Fire Evacuation.  I have been an officer for the Communications Squad and also as First Lieutenant in the organization.  I also provide technical support for Radio Communications, computers and other technical activities.
